assumptions: 0 < alpha < 1/2 for the displayed three-way walk
Real-valued state on the whole real line, not a strictly positive stock-price model
Ordinary Gaussian density evaluated only for tau > 0

refinement_lab.histogram_height: exact point probability divided by h; full trinomial support displayed
refinement_lab.sampling: Exact deterministic convolution; no Monte Carlo randomness or seed

added_clarifications: Mass vs density and zero continuous point probability
Discrete backward recurrence is exact for M_h, not for finite-step Gaussian k
Dirac initial condition understood through integrals; source title mentions it but main pages do not develop it
Similarity integration constant zero by symmetry
Endpoint of open interval at zero elapsed time differs from one-sided Gaussian limit
Increasing N alone is not model validation
